text:
deploybot: Canary started: payments-service chart 2.15.0 -> rolling 3 pods (10% traffic). Observed 2/3 pods restart within 30s of ready. health: degraded. logs: SIGTERM then OOMKill on app container. tag: eu-west1 cluster.

alex: argh. I saw similar in staging earlier. quick check: values.yaml may have terminationGracePeriodSeconds and affinity changes.

maria: :eyes: can you paste the pod describe?

deploybot: pod describe snippet: 
```
Name: payments-abc-1
Status: Running
Events:
  Warning  Killing  3s (x2 over 20s)  kubelet  Container killed with exit code 137 (OOMKilled)
  Normal   Killing  2s (x2 over 20s)  kubelet  Stopping container payments (SIGTERM)
```

alex: quick grep in the release values shows `terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 5` in the override file. That seems too low for our shutdown hooks.

sam: who changed that? 5 -> should be 30 or 60 depending on shutdown sequence.

maria: also notice podAntiAffinity tightened in chart bump, so pods are scheduled on nodes with less free memory. combined effect -> OOM during graceful drain.

jen: TL;DR: chart bump increased sidecar memory slightly and values lowered terminationGracePeriod. Canary can't finish shutdown, restarts -> rolling flaps.

alex: proposal: pin chart to 2.14.3 for the remainder of the window and push a values hotfix (increase terminationGracePeriodSeconds to 40) to 2.15.0 canary when ready. rollforward only after validating 5-min soak.

maria: agree. We should also relax the antiAffinity for canary to avoid co-locating on memory-constrained nodes. quick patch: `affinity: null` in canary overlay.

sam: +1 on pin+hotfix. Can we do a live patch to the canary values and re-run canary (no full promotion)?

deploybot: I can apply values patch to the canary release (helm upgrade --reuse-values --set terminationGracePeriodSeconds=40 --namespace prod). Want me to run now?

oncall-sre: pinging infra to watch node memory during the next 15m. I'll open a watch.

jen: if we're pinning, notify release-notes and set a rollback garden-var to auto-rollback if >20% of canary pods OOM within 10m.

maria: sample command for the hotfix (for docs):
```
helm upgrade payments-service --namespace prod payments-chart-2.15.0 \
  --reuse-values --set-file values.hotfix.yaml \
  --set terminationGracePeriodSeconds=40,affinity=""
```

alex: I'll create the values.hotfix.yaml and push; will trigger deploybot when ready.

sam: do we need to update release notes? It's a values-only hotfix, but call it out under "stability fixes". jen can you take a 1-line?

jen: yep, will add: "Hotfix: increased terminationGracePeriodSeconds and relaxed affinity for payments-service canary to avoid OOMs during shutdown (temporary pin to 2.14.3 for stable traffic)."

sre-bot: Incident guard: if canary OOM rate > 20% OR request latency p95 increases > 2x, will auto-rollback.

deploybot: applying patch now to canary overlay... 
deploybot: helm exit: success; 2/3 pods restarted cleanly, currently 3/3 ready. health checks passing.

alex: nice. monitor for 10m, then slowly increase traffic to 20%.

oncall-sre: watching metrics, will slack updates.

maria: after 15m soak we should promote or leave pinned until next release window. leaning to keep pinned and schedule a proper chart revert or fix in the next patch release.

sam: agreed. I'll create the follow-up task to revert antiAffinity change in chart repo and bump TGPS in the next minor.

jen: release-notes updated and I added a short blurb to the canary changelog.

alex: final: pin stable traffic to 2.14.3 for now, hotfix applied to canary values, watch period started. thanks all. :thumbsup:
